scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic Cayley and Routh certificates are reproducible in the included script; finite numerical probes are corroborative and not general proof. Previously reported lower- and fourth-order results are acknowledged rather than recertified.
scientific_limitations: All real t>0 for integer m=0,1,2,3; only three exact witnesses for m=4. No result for m>=5 or arbitrary boundary exponents. Priority risk from unlocated generalized Eulerian/Schur stability theory. No independent validation.
title: The first reentrant boundary order for Jacobi-weighted disk kernels
